headline: The neighborhood grew to six
lede: Papers, Please-Min's line got two more authored regulars — a knit-seller with freckles and a retired clerk with a forehead bandage — every recurring face now speaks in its own voice, and a rotating window lets six seats share the walk without losing a single return.

notes.text: SONYA MALAK and TADEK HRUBY are authored end to end — fixed faces, signature marks, personal greetings and callbacks — merged as #1999; paperscheck is at 13936 gates with all 34 mutants dead.

Widening the cast naively would have killed recurrence: six seats over six cast days means every face walks once and never comes back. The fix is a rotating window — each week meets four seats, and the first two return on days 6 and 7, so the wanted-turn still lands on a familiar face.

Seed 4's live browser week proves it with real keystrokes: Sonya greets at the counter in her scarf and earring, the wanted sheet on day 6 carries HER passport number, and Tadek's day-7 return answers 'YOU LET ME THROUGH.'
Speech is atmosphere, lawfully: the purity witness that used to read the arc day now strips every line off every paper of every seed — no verdict ever flinches.
